# Check every form before adding a shared port tooltip

The shared Port label is used by email and LDAP forms. Its old tooltip said to use0 for autodetection; the landing replaces it with a value-only label. Current owners require numeric ports1–65535, and the incoming validator passes that range to the throwing integerRange helper. A shared label cannot promise the same detection behavior for every consumer. The separate blank-field auto-description does not establish that all forms accept blank fields. Static source only; no port probing, rendered tooltip or accessibility test.

Scope: Account Hub shared Port label consumers.
